assertions.text: Identifies that the route handler calls the repository directly instead of going through an application/use-case layer
Identifies that the void-invoice invariant (Invoice.markPaid()) is bypassed because the route updates the row directly, i.e. flags the resulting reachable bug, not just the structural smell
Identifies that the raw DB row is returned directly from the GET endpoint instead of a mapped DTO/domain-shaped response
Proposes concrete restructuring: a use case that the route calls, with domain rule enforcement and mapping at the boundary
